name: COLONEL FANSHAWE
note: FANSHAWE IN THE STREET, waiting, pleased with himself; he calls the duel (Main Street's accost). Doc 57 F4: 'The first time Thad steps onto the street after T_ASSAY_RUN, Fanshawe is waiting with half the town and the judges' table on the boardwalk, Sowerby holding the pencil.' Cut from room-02 operations 1 and 2 by tools/art/room02-duel-cast.py and laid over Room 2's own street. Present for the visit the duel is called on (T_DUEL_CROWD), and gone the next time.
barksNote: The duel is spoken through the assay (content/assay/assay.json).

sprite.frameNote: 0 thumbs in his waistcoat, his top hat on · 1 breath (derived) · 2 a hand held out · 3 the watch · 4 tipping his hat. Breathing on 0 and 1; every `breakEvery` seconds one break (errata 77).
sprite.redrawn: Errata 101 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from the locked cast master, cast-unify operation 17 (reference/cast-unify-15.txt), full figure in his top hat, cut with its own pixels and a clean edge on his feet, at the figureHeight he had. Its own file: tools/art/cast-unify-duel.py writes the old one.
sprite.figureHeightNote: Crown to sole, not hat to sole: the top hat is not part of his height (first set to the frame's height, it drew the man under it about 11% short). Measured from the hat's brim, plus the forehead above it.

walkToNote: Facing him across the street, as the master stood them.
